result.summary: Found 1 issue: a major missing-element problem where a restaurant card is displaying a broken image placeholder instead of actual content.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' displays a broken/empty image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo.
issues.suggestion: Ensure a valid image URL is provided for this restaurant, or implement a graceful fallback (e.g., a default restaurant icon or colored background) so the card doesn't look broken.
